copy.curiosityHook: With zero study habits and prison awaiting them if they fail, how will these hopeless students survive their final exams?
copy.description: At a private Versailles school, a class of struggling underachievers accidentally dynamites the building during a prank. Hauled into court, they face an ultimatum: pass their graduation exams or go to prison.
copy.vibeSummary: Lighthearted, fast-moving school farce that makes for a low-demand, laugh-out-loud watch with friends.
copy.whyWatch: Claude Zidi delivers an undemanding French farce packed with broad laughs and escalating absurdity, turning high-school scholastic desperation into a breezy comic romp.

allowedMaterial: underachieving graduating class at a private Versailles school
misfired prank that dynamites the school
court ultimatum requiring them to pass exams or face prison
excludedMaterial: court outcomes and final exam results
